newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Alanian president pardons jailed opposition leader.
newsitem.headline: Alanian president pardons jailed opposition leader.

text.p: President Sali Berisha of Albania on Sunday announced a pardon for Fatos Nano, the jailed leader of the opposition Socialist Party who was freed from prison earlier this week.
Nano, jailed in 1993 on corruption charges which the opposition said were politically inspired, was among 51 prisoners with less than two years to serve who were pardoned by presidential decree.
